home.featured_subtitle: You're doing great — keep your streak alive.
home.title: Home
home.screen_time_permission: Allow Screen Time to show your real data.
home.screen_time_unavailable: Screen Time data is available on iPhone.
home.usage_missing: Your real data will appear here as soon as iOS has calculated it.
home.score_detail_formula: Each axis compares today against the median of your last 7 complete days, scaled to the elapsed hour. A ratio of 1 scores 50, a ratio of 0.5 scores 100, a ratio of 2 scores 0. The global score is the average of both. These usage indicators measure neither your focus nor your sleep.
home.score_detail_unavailable: Relock does not have enough measured days yet to compare you with your own habit. The score will appear on its own once a baseline exists.
home.score_footer_excellent: A day well held. Keep this rhythm!
home.score_footer_good: Every point counts. Keep it up!
home.score_footer_fair: One more block today would make the difference.
home.score_footer_poor: Protect one moment of your day to bring the score back up.
home.score_footer_pending: Your score arrives once a few days have been measured.
home.score_what_body: A daily marker of your phone use. It compares you to no one but yourself: today against YOUR own habit, computed over your last 7 days. 50 means “as usual”, 100 “twice as good”, 0 “twice as bad”.
home.score_how_focus: Your pickups per elapsed hour, against your 7-day median. Fragmentation is what counts, not volume: 60 pickups over 16 h is not 60 over 4 h.
home.score_how_rest: Your screen time per elapsed hour, against the same baseline. A lighter day than your usual raises Rest.
home.score_tip_block: Block the apps you open most: fewer pickups, more Focus.
home.score_tip_focus: Batch your notifications: Focus drops with the number of openings, not their length.
home.score_tip_rest: Schedule a screen-free slot in the evening: Rest climbs while the phone stays down.
home.score_note: The score compares you to yourself, never to an outside average. Until Relock has enough measured days it shows “calculating” rather than an invented number — and it stays approximate for the first few days, while your baseline forms.
home.streak_detail_waiting: Start a protection today to grow your streak.
home.streak_detail_rule: A day counts when at least one Relock protection is active. You do not need to open the app.
home.new_user_body: Choose a few apps and protect your first moment of the day.
home.data_error: Some data could not be refreshed. Relock will try again automatically.
home.permission_settings_body: Open Settings > Screen Time and allow Relock to manage Screen Time.
home.score_footer_provisional: Still approximate — the score sharpens every day.
home.score_footer_focus_poor: You are drifting often today. A block would help you hold on.
home.score_footer_focus_fair: Your attention is fragmenting: a lot of back and forth today.
home.score_footer_focus_good: Good rhythm. You reach for your phone a bit more than usual.
home.score_footer_focus_excellent: Focused day: your attention is holding.
home.score_footer_rest_poor: A lot of screen time today. Give yourself a real break.
home.score_footer_rest_fair: You are spending more time on screen than usual.
home.score_footer_rest_good: Good rhythm, with slightly more screen time than your average.
home.score_footer_rest_excellent: Focused day: you are leaving your screen alone.
